en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
enH: What will explain to you what the Crashing Blow is?
bn: মহা বিপদ সম্পর্কে তুমি কী জান?

en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
enH: On a Day when people will be like scattered moths
bn: সে দিন মানুষ হবে বিক্ষিপ্ত পতঙ্গের মত

en: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
enH: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
bn: আর পর্বতগুলো হবে ধুনা রঙ্গিন পশমের মত।

en: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
enH: the one whose good deeds are heavy on the scales
bn: অতঃপর যার (সৎ কর্মের) পাল্লা ভারি হবে।

en: He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
enH: but the one whose good deeds are light

en: His refuge will be an abyss.
enH: will have the Bottomless Pit for his home––

en: And what can make you know what that is?
enH: what will explain to you what that is?––

en: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
